entry.title: Kota Engaku and the Art of Individuality

media:group.media:title: Kota Engaku and the Art of Individuality
media:group.media:description:
In Tokyo, where creativity and chaos coexist in equal measure, Kota Engaku has carved out a world entirely his own. A publisher, tastemaker and lifelong car enthusiast, Kota moves between custom motorcycles, classic design and a collection of Bentleys with the same unwavering sense of individuality.​
​His fascination with Bentley began in his twenties, sparked by a memorable late-night drive in a borrowed Bentley that left a lasting impression. Decades later, that connection endures behind the wheel of his cherished Arnage R. For Kota, the appeal lies deeper than performance. He sees a kinship between Bentley’s heritage of craftsmanship and the custom motorcycle culture he lives and breathes, where every detail reflects the personality of its owner.​
Threading through Tokyo’s neon-lit streets, the Arnage offers something increasingly rare: calm, authenticity and space to think. In a city that never stands still, Kota finds inspiration in a Bentley, not simply as a means of transport, but as a handcrafted companion for the journey.​
​#Bentley #BentleyStories

media:group.media:title: Flying Spur S: Power Refined
media:group.media:description:
The new Flying Spur S reveals its character through the way it drives.​
A High Performance Hybrid powertrain delivering 680 PS and 930 Nm provides effortless performance, while Bentley Performance Active Chassis, torque vectoring and an electronic limited-slip differential work together to enhance precision and control.​
Distinctive dark detailing signals its sporting intent, yet the refinement, craftsmanship and comfort of a Flying Spur remain unchanged.​
Discover more - https://bit.ly/4dOcKVe
#Bentley #BentleyFlyingSpurS
Flying Spur Speed (hybrid) WLTP drive cycle: Electrical consumption weighted, combined – 19.9 (kWh/100km). Fuel consumption combined with discharged battery – 26.4 (10.7) mpg (l/100km) . Fuel consumption weighted, combined – 64 (4.4) mpg (l/100km). CO₂ emissions weighted, combined – 100 g/km. CO₂ class weighted, combined – C. CO₂ class with discharged battery – G.

entry.title: A Car Worth Waiting For: Leyla Hajrovic's Bentley Continental GT

media:group.media:title: A Car Worth Waiting For: Leyla Hajrovic's Bentley Continental GT
media:group.media:description:
A car worth waiting for is a car worth dreaming about.​
For Leyla Hajrovic, the Bentley Continental GT was always the one. Long before she could drive, she knew exactly what she wanted. Sixteen years later, that dream became reality.​
​Drawn to its craftsmanship, understated power and timeless design, Leyla found more than a car. She found an expression of her personal style.​
​From the streets of Zurich to the roads beyond Lake Zug, her Continental GT delivers the perfect balance of performance, refinement and confidence.​
Discover more - https://bit.ly/4y5aQYt
​#Bentley #BentleyContinentalGT

entry.title: Dennis Schröder | Driven by something deeper

media:group.media:title: Dennis Schröder | Driven by something deeper
media:group.media:description:
The defining moments are only part of the story.
For Dennis Schröder, the journey has always been driven by something deeper: family, purpose and the belief that dedication will be rewarded.
Following a promise he made as a teenager, he devoted himself fully to basketball. Through discipline, determination and unwavering belief, that commitment carried him to the highest level of the game.
Among the many milestones in his career, those achieved representing Germany remain especially significant, culminating in FIBA World Cup victory and tournament MVP honours in 2023.
With the new Bentley Continental GT, Dennis reflects on the values that continue to drive him forward.
#Bentley #BentleyContinentalGT

media:group.media:title: The All-New Bentley Torcal
media:group.media:description:
Introducing the new Bentley Torcal.
More than a new name, the Torcal marks a new chapter for Bentley. Joining the Continental GT, Flying Spur and Bentayga as the fourth model in the range, it balances a bold vision for the future with the craftsmanship, performance and attention to detail that have defined Bentley since 1919.
Its sleek new design language draws inspiration from more than a century of heritage, while advanced technology, exceptional craftsmanship and a focus on passenger wellbeing create a Bentley unlike any before it.
An all-new Bentley, marking a pivotal moment in the Bentley story.
Discover more - https://bit.ly/4dSHTHU
#Bentley #BentleyTorcal
CO2 Emissions, electricity consumption data and electric range for EU27 are pending, subject to EU Type Approval.

media:group.media:description:

For 80 years, Bentleys have been built in this factory, brought to life by skilled hands and using techniques often passed down through generations. The new Torcal is no different. Handcrafted.
